command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p genome

echo "== bismark version (Rust suite, one binary) =="
bismark --version > ver.txt 2>&1 || true
awk 'NR==1' ver.txt

echo "== fixture: 1kb reference whose ONLY CpGs are the three we plant =="
cat > gen.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{
  srand(5); split("ACGT",B,"")
  N=1000
  for(i=1;i<=N;i++) r[i]=B[int(rand()*4)+1]
  # remove every CG dinucleotide so the only CpGs are the ones we plant
  for(i=1;i<N;i++) if(r[i]=="C" && r[i+1]=="G") r[i+1]="A"
  split("200 400 600", P, " ")
  for(k=1;k<=3;k++){ p=P[k]+0; r[p]="C"; r[p+1]="G" }
  # re-check: planting could have created a neighbouring CG
  for(i=1;i<N;i++){ isplanted=0; for(k=1;k<=3;k++) if(i==P[k]+0) isplanted=1
    if(!isplanted && r[i]=="C" && r[i+1]=="G") r[i+1]="A" }
  s=""; for(i=1;i<=N;i++) s=s r[i]
  print ">chrS"  > "genome/chrS.fa"
  print s        > "genome/chrS.fa"
  # planted methylation: site -> (methylated, unmethylated)
  meth[1]=10; unmeth[1]=0      # 100%
  meth[2]=5;  unmeth[2]=5      # 50%
  meth[3]=0;  unmeth[3]=10     # 0%
  L=100; n=0
  for(k=1;k<=3;k++){
    p=P[k]+0; start=p-50
    for(j=1;j<=meth[k]+unmeth[k];j++){
      ismeth = (j<=meth[k])
      read=""
      for(i=start;i<start+L;i++){
        c=r[i]
        if(c=="C"){ if(i==p && ismeth) c="C"; else c="T" }   # directional bisulfite: unmethylated C -> T
        read=read c
      }
      n++
      q=""; for(i=0;i<L;i++) q=q "I"
      printf "@m%d_site%d\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, p, read, q > "reads.fq"
    }
    printf "chrS\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", p, meth[k], unmeth[k] > "truth.tsv"
  }
  printf "cpg_sites 3 at 200,400,600  reads %d  planted_meth 10/0, 5/5, 0/10\n", n
}
AWKEOF
awk -f gen.awk | tee fixture.txt
CGCOUNT=$(grep -o CG genome/chrS.fa | wc -l | tr -d " ")
echo "cg_dinucleotides_in_reference $CGCOUNT"
sort -k2,2n truth.tsv -o truth.tsv

echo "== prepare (CT + GA converted indices) =="
bismark prepare genome --bowtie2 > prep.log 2>&1

echo "== align (directional bisulfite) =="
bismark align --genome genome --single_end reads.fq > align.log 2>&1
MAPEFF=$(awk -F'\t' '/Mapping efficiency/{gsub(/%/,"",$2); print $2}' reads_bismark_bt2_SE_report.txt)
NONUNIQ=$(awk -F'\t' '/did not map uniquely/{print $2}' reads_bismark_bt2_SE_report.txt)

echo "== extract methylation calls =="
bismark extract -s --bedGraph --comprehensive reads_bismark_bt2.bam > ext.log 2>&1
for f in *.cov*; do case "$f" in *.gz) gunzip -c "$f";; *) cat "$f";; esac; done | sort -k2,2n > cov.txt
awk '{printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", $1, $2, $5, $6}' cov.txt | sort -k2,2n > got.tsv
cp got.tsv bismark_calls.tsv
cp genome/chrS.fa chrS.fa
cat cov.txt

NSITES=$(wc -l < got.tsv | tr -d " ")
CALLS=$(awk '{s+=$5+$6} END{print s+0}' cov.txt)
READS=$(awk '/reads/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="reads") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)
EXACT=no; cmp -s truth.tsv got.tsv && EXACT=yes

{
  echo "Bismark -- methylation calls checked against cytosines we methylated ourselves"
  echo "bismark_version       $(awk 'NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^v[0-9]/){print $i; exit}}' ver.txt)"
  echo "reference_cpgs        $CGCOUNT   (assert 3 -- every other CG was removed, so there is nothing else to find)"
  echo "mapping_efficiency    ${MAPEFF}%   non_unique $NONUNIQ"
  echo "sites_reported        $NSITES   (assert 3 -- no spurious calls)"
  echo "calls_exact           $EXACT   (assert yes -- EXACT: per-site methylated/unmethylated counts equal the planted values)"
  echo "total_calls           $CALLS of $READS reads   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION: each read covers exactly one CpG)"
  echo "planted_range         100% (10/0), 50% (5/5), 0% (0/10) -- the 0% site proves C->T is read as unmethylated, not as a mismatch"
} > smoke-check-bismark.txt
cat smoke-check-bismark.txt

test "$CGCOUNT" -eq 3
test "$NSITES" -eq 3
test "$EXACT" = yes
test "$CALLS" -eq "$READS"
test "$NONUNIQ" -eq 0
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
